title: Enforce only the coverage standards the team chooses
statement: As a change author, I can ask whether selected documentation areas are complete, so that I can enforce only the standards my team chooses.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The check succeeds when every selected area is fully covered.
The check returns a failing result with only the selected areas' gaps when coverage is incomplete.
A comparison-scoped check evaluates the selected change and its affected documentation.
An unscoped check evaluates the whole application.
A feature-scoped check evaluates only that feature.
